messages:
maria: Quick sync — we discovered a few gaps in the console telemetry for the observability roadmap that we need owners on before EOW. TL;DR: dashboard gaps, tracing hook for gRPC flows, error-analysis ingestion bug, and retention schedule for traces.

ryan: I can take the dashboard gaps — which panels are missing?

maria: Thanks @ryan. Mostly the error-rate by API route panel and a grouped-by-model latency heatmap. The error-rate one needs an adjusted query to include 5xx logged errors from the proxy layer + app errors.

jess: For the grouped heatmap I have a draft grafana panel def in my PR (link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/332). Needs review for template variables.

maria: Perfect. @jess can you reassign reviewers? Prefer @dmitri for the query correctness and @ryan for layout.

jess: Yup, pinged them both.

dmitri: Quick note on the tracing hook: the gRPC span sampler is dropping spans for short lived streams. I think we need to bump the sampling window and add a prefix match for internal service-names so we don't keep everything.

sam: I ran a quick sim — bumping sample_window_ms to 50 and adding service_prefix: "internal-" keeps noise down and retains relevant RPC spans.

maria: Can we get a small config snippet to include in the infra change? Also we need a retrofittable migration so existing traces don't get lost for the canary window.

sam: snippet:```yaml
tracing:
  sampler:
    sample_window_ms: 50
    service_prefixes:
      - "internal-"
    max_spans_per_request: 200
```

sam: For migration, we should keep the old sampler on for 48h during canary then flip. That avoids any sudden drop in upstream dashboards.

ryan: Noted. I'll add the canary rollout steps to the runbook and link to the infra PR.

maria: Error-analysis ingestion bug: currently logs with nested json "error.context" are not being picked up by the parser — we lose stack and error_kind. @dmitri any idea?

dmitri: Yeah that's the tokenizer rule we added last quarter; it flattens a nested field only when depth <=1. Easy fix but it affects the schema — needs migration for existing indexed docs. I'll put an RFC patch.

jess: If that changes schema we need a heads-up to data retention and cost team. Might change index size for 30d -> 90d sliding windows.

maria: Speaking of retention — we need to finalize trace retention tiers. Proposal: 14d for dev, 90d for standard customers, 365d for enterprise (locked behind Dedicated/Private). Any objections?

ryan: +1 for tiers. One ask: make the standard 90d configurable per-customer with a quota check.

sam: Implementation note: storage backend supports TTL per-tenant but the export job needs to be updated to respect per-tenant overrides. Low effort but add to sprint.

maria: OK assigning retention implementation to @sam (backend) and @ryan (console UI exposure). Target milestone: ship canary + dashboard updates by next Wednesday.

dmitri: I'll own the parser patch and the trace sampling change validations. ETA for both: Tue end-of-day if no blockers.

jess: I'll finish the panel PR review today and then help with dashboard rollout checklist.

maria: Thanks team. Action items recap: 
• ryan: dashboard layout + runbook canary steps
• jess: panel PR, template vars, rollout checklist
• dmitri: parser fix + validation tests
• sam: sampling config PR + retention TTL change in export job

maria: If anyone hits blockers, drop a quick note here. Also tagging infra-bot for a cluster capacity check for the 90d canary (we might need temporary extra shards). @infra-bot can you run a capacity estimate?

infra-bot: Capacity estimate started. ETA ~30m. Current cluster usage: 72%. Projected usage with 90d standard rollout + canary traffic: 84% peak. Recommend 1 extra data node for a 2-week canary.

maria: Cool — I'll open a cost approval ticket. One last thing: @ryan can you confirm the alert thresholds for the error-rate panel so we don't get noisy alerts during canary?

ryan: I'll set alerts to trigger at 3x baseline and add a silent window during the first 6h of canary.

maria: Great. Thanks all.

sam: tagging the PRs here: sampling config: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/340, retention backend: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/341

jess: dashboard panel: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/332 (again)

maria: I'll follow up with a short status update in the weekly eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
